aboutText: With over 20 years of experience serving the Footscray community, Boxshall Group has established itself as a trusted provider of electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical services. Our team of licensed professionals is committed to delivering reliable and innovative solutions tailored to the unique needs of industrial and commercial clients. We pride ourselves on our attention to detail, prompt service, and sustainable practices that ensure long-term value for our customers.
servicesText: Boxshall Group offers a comprehensive range of trade services designed to meet all your electrical, hydraulic, and HVAC needs. From initial design and construct projects to ongoing maintenance, our skilled team ensures efficient and high-quality workmanship. We specialise in sustainable solutions that enhance performance while reducing environmental impact.
